d.tr: Can't this be made into a normal call from Bangalore?
d.ctx: The user starts the call by asking about making a normal call instead, and the expert responds about currency charges.
d.j: Matches the strong case of asking for a call outside the app (normal call).

d.tr: Will you do it on WhatsApp? I will give it, come do it on WhatsApp.

d.j: Matches the strong case of proposing to move to a named external app.
